name: r3_seed_refactor
description: REAL refactor-stale-memory fixture from yawn.seed history (auth_payload_refactor_stale_memory family). LocalDataSourceService was a 1200-line god-class that got split: DTO->entity mapping extracted to CardIngestMapper (commit c9940ae, ~480 lines out, 1200->723) and the repo/script sync phase extracted to RepoSyncService (commit cb2d013). Memories pinned to 'X lives in LocalDataSourceService' are now stale — the classic refactor-stale-memory poisoning case. Provenance: git log yawn.seed (c9940ae, cb2d013, 7e6c22e). Gold labels grounded in cited commits; ctharvey confirmation pending. intent=current ('where does this live in yawn.seed now?').
